currentState: current-certification-state.json resolves the latest certificate per subject; it is derived state, not the certificate history.
evidence: Evidence references must identify real persisted evidence. Agents must not fabricate test, build, runtime, physical, or hardware results.
history: certificates.jsonl is append-only; a retest always creates a new certificate ID and never rewrites prior certificates.
passRule: PASS requires all applicable required evidence to be present and verified. Missing physical or on-target evidence cannot produce HARDWARE_CERTIFIED PASS.
projectMemory: CERTIFICATION_STARTED, CERTIFICATE_ISSUED, and CERTIFICATE_FAILED are also recorded in the Project Memory event log.
status: PROJECT_STATUS.md may summarize current certification, while certificates.jsonl remains the durable evidence source.
